title: Prototype UI-heavy videos in Seedance 2.0 by attaching several high‑resolution…
content: Prototype UI-heavy videos in Seedance 2.0 by attaching several high‑resolution reference images; generating without references tends to produce messy UI and unreadable text.
tips: Prototype UI-heavy videos in Seedance 2.0 by attaching several high‑resolution reference images; generating without references tends to produce messy UI and unreadable text.

en.content: Prototype UI-heavy videos in Seedance 2.0 by attaching several high-resolution reference images; generating without references tends to produce messy UI and unreadable text.

es.content: Prototipa videos con mucha interfaz en Seedance 2.0 adjuntando varias imágenes de referencia de alta resolución; generar sin referencias suele producir una UI desordenada y texto ilegible.

fr.content: Prototypez des vidéos à forte composante UI dans Seedance 2.0 en joignant plusieurs images de référence en haute résolution ; générer sans références a tendance à produire une interface brouillonne et du texte illisible.

ja.content: Seedance 2.0 では、複数の高解像度の参照画像を添付することで、UI中心の動画をプロトタイプできます。参照なしで生成すると、UI が乱れたり、テキストが読めなくなったりしがちです。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0에서 여러 장의 고해상도 레퍼런스 이미지를 첨부해 UI 중심의 프로토타입 영상을 제작하세요. 레퍼런스 없이 생성하면 UI가 지저분해지고 텍스트를 읽기 어려워지는 경향이 있습니다.

pt.content: Prototipe vídeos com forte presença de UI no Seedance 2.0 anexando várias imagens de referência em alta resolução; gerar sem referências tende a produzir uma UI confusa e texto ilegível.

zh.content: 通过附加多张高分辨率参考图像，在 Seedance 2.0 中原型化 UI 密集型视频；不使用参考图生成时，往往会导致 UI 混乱、文字难以辨认。
